Condominium in Mai Khao
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleMaviston Mai Khao

Developer renders and marketing images (Keller Henson project page and the official Maviston website). Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Maviston Mai Khao is a condominium in Mai Khao, on Phuket's northwest coast, with one to three bedroom units according to listings. Sources name Mai Khao Golden Beach as the developer.

It is a condominium, not a villa project. Completion is quoted anywhere between 2026 and Q4 2027, so ask us for the current construction status. Some sources advertise rental guarantees of 6 or 7%; we have not verified any of them and do not repeat them as an offer.

Prices start from roughly 9 million baht in listings. Message us on WhatsApp for the price list.

Maviston Mai Khao: key facts

  • Maviston Mai Khao is a condominium in Mai Khao, Phuket, developed by Mai Khao Golden Beach.
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 64–114.87 sqm.
  • Construction status: status on request; completion listed as Dec 2026.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿9,300,000.
